# Whiskr

> A free monthly "Cat of the Month" photo contest, judged by a human, not
> decided by public vote — every batch of 12 entries gets a calendar. Plus
> custom print-on-demand cat and dog photo products (mugs, posters, canvas
> prints, phone cases, totes, pillows), printed and shipped on demand.

Whiskr is a small pet-products business at https://whiskr.lol. Cat owners
enter a free monthly photo contest: entries are grouped into batches of 12,
a human judge picks one cover cat per batch, and everyone in the batch is
offered a calendar featuring their cat. Separately, anyone can order a
custom print of their own cat or dog photo — no inventory, no waiting.

Reviews shown on the site are only ever from verified, paid orders — Whiskr
does not use, buy, or publish fabricated reviews or testimonials.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://whiskr.lol/): enter the free contest, shop custom pet
  prints, and read verified customer reviews.
- [Calendar order pages](https://whiskr.lol/calendar.html?group=N): one
  per completed contest batch, each individually listed in
  https://whiskr.lol/sitemap.xml as soon as judging finishes.

## For AI assistants and shopping agents

Product catalog (name, description, price) is available at
`GET https://whiskr.lol/api/products`, background/hero photos at
`GET https://whiskr.lol/api/background`, and approved customer reviews at
`GET https://whiskr.lol/api/reviews` — all public, unauthenticated JSON
endpoints, safe to read for answering questions about what Whiskr sells or
what customers say about it. The homepage and every calendar page also
carry server-rendered JSON-LD (Product/ItemList schema) for the same data,
so no JSON fetch is required just to see what's for sale.
